name: FCAS Provincial Funding for wild Atlantic salmon conservation

funder.name: Foundation for Conservation of Atlantic Salmon

summary: Annual grants of CAD 5,000 to 50,000 a year for wild Atlantic salmon habitat conservation, restoration and watershed planning by community groups, Indigenous organisations and others in Atlantic Canada and Quebec.

status.quote: Provincial Funding Applications are now open to organizations in Atlantic Canada and Quebec who wish to apply for 2027 funding toward an Atlantic salmon conservation project.

deadline.quote: Application Deadline: Friday 27 November 2026 by 5:00 pm EST

applicant_types.quote: Non-governmental organizations (e.g. community-based conservation organizations, cooperatives, watershed-based organizations, etc.) Municipalities Education institutions Indigenous Organizations

geography.quote: The proposed project must be located in a watershed within the provinces of Québec, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia or Newfoundland and Labrador.

access.quote: All forms from New Brunswick and Québec can be submitted directly by e-mail to kristen@salmonconservation.ca .

window.quote: Application Deadline: Friday 27 November 2026 by 5:00 pm EST

amount.quote: Submissions for individual projects should not be less than $5,000 nor exceed a maximum of $50,000 (per year).
